aries_1.title: Aries Decan 1
aries_1.summary: Ruled by Mars, this decan embodies pure Aries energy, characterized by bold independence and a trailblazing spirit.
aries_1.fullText: Covering the first 10 degrees of Aries, this decan is ruled solely by Mars. It represents the purest expression of the sign, granting the native an assertive, forceful, and highly energetic nature. These individuals are natural pioneers who dive headlong into new projects with enthusiasm and courage.

aries_2.title: Aries Decan 2
aries_2.summary: Sub-ruled by the Sun, this decan blends Aries initiative with Leo's proud, ambitious, and magnetic vitality.
aries_2.fullText: This decan carries a secondary Leo influence, governed by the Sun. It adds immense pride, dignity, and a love for the spotlight to the standard Aries drive. Natives here are highly ambitious, magnetic leaders who are fond of change and constantly seek to put their unique mark on the world.

aries_3.title: Aries Decan 3
aries_3.summary: Sub-ruled by Jupiter, this decan infuses Aries energy with Sagittarius's philosophical foresight and boundless optimism.
aries_3.fullText: Influenced by Sagittarius and sub-ruled by Jupiter, this decan operates on a grand, adventurous scale. These natives possess a restless, exploratory spirit, combining raw Martian drive with an optimistic, philosophical outlook. They are often shrewd in business and incredibly warm-hearted, though sometimes prone to extravagance.

taurus_1.title: Taurus Decan 1
taurus_1.summary: Ruled by Venus, this decan represents pure Taurus energy, focusing intensely on sensual pleasure and steadfast material acquisition.
taurus_1.fullText: Covering the first 10 degrees of Taurus, this decan is ruled purely by Venus. It highlights the most traditional Taurean traits: a deep love for beauty, luxury, and physical comforts. Natives are extremely determined, practical, and heavily focused on cultivating enduring material security and harmonious relationships.

taurus_2.title: Taurus Decan 2
taurus_2.summary: Sub-ruled by Mercury, this decan blends Taurean stability with Virgo's analytical, communicative, and assessing intellect.
taurus_2.fullText: This decan carries a secondary Virgo influence, governed by Mercury. It sharpens the Taurean mind, creating a highly practical, observant, and communicative intellect. These natives are exceptionally thorough and analytical in their approach to the material world, making them shrewd judges of value and excellent planners.

taurus_3.title: Taurus Decan 3
taurus_3.summary: Sub-ruled by Saturn, this decan infuses Taurus endurance with Capricorn's relentless discipline and deep-seated ambition.
taurus_3.fullText: Influenced by Capricorn and sub-ruled by Saturn, this decan is characterized by immense patience and a rigorous work ethic. These natives are incredibly loyal, responsible, and protective of their resources. They approach life's challenges with serious determination and rarely evade hard work when building their empires.

gemini_1.title: Gemini Decan 1
gemini_1.summary: Ruled by Mercury, this decan embodies pure Gemini energy, characterized by a quicksilver intellect and boundless curiosity.
gemini_1.fullText: Covering the first 10 degrees of Gemini, this decan is ruled entirely by Mercury. It represents the purest expression of the sign, highlighting mental agility, loquaciousness, and a brilliant, logical mind. These natives process the world rapidly through language and constantly seek new intellectual stimulation.

gemini_2.title: Gemini Decan 2
gemini_2.summary: Sub-ruled by Venus, this decan blends Gemini wit with Libra's charming, romantic, and highly sociable nature.
gemini_2.fullText: This decan carries a secondary Libra influence, governed by Venus. It softens the nervous mental energy of Gemini, adding a strong desire for harmony, aesthetics, and romantic connection. These individuals are exceptionally charming, tactful, and possess a warm, sensuous approach to interpersonal communication.

gemini_3.title: Gemini Decan 3
gemini_3.summary: Sub-ruled by Uranus, this decan infuses Gemini logic with Aquarius's objective, inventive, and fiercely independent reason.
gemini_3.fullText: Influenced by Aquarius and sub-ruled by Uranus, this decan operates with profound, progressive objectivity. These natives possess a highly original, inventive point of view and approach life through abstract, rational concepts. They are brilliant problem-solvers who deeply value their intellectual freedom.

cancer_1.title: Cancer Decan 1
cancer_1.summary: Ruled by the Moon, this decan represents pure Cancer energy, deeply attuned to profound emotion and maternal receptiveness.
cancer_1.fullText: Covering the first 10 degrees of Cancer, this decan is ruled purely by the Moon. It highlights the most essential traits of the sign: immense sensitivity, empathy, and a powerful nurturing instinct. Natives process reality entirely through their feelings, seeking to create strong, protective emotional sanctuaries.

cancer_2.title: Cancer Decan 2
cancer_2.summary: Sub-ruled by Pluto, this decan blends Cancerian sensitivity with Scorpio's extreme psychological depth and intense willpower.
cancer_2.fullText: This decan carries a secondary Scorpio influence, governed by Pluto. It adds an intense, magnetic, and often secretive layer to the native's emotional world. These individuals possess profound psychological insight, fierce loyalty, and a powerful, regenerative resilience hidden beneath their protective outer shells.

cancer_3.title: Cancer Decan 3
cancer_3.summary: Sub-ruled by Neptune, this decan infuses Cancerian emotion with Pisces's boundless, romantic, and spiritual empathy.
cancer_3.fullText: Influenced by Pisces and sub-ruled by Neptune, this decan is marked by incredible imagination and artistic potential. These natives are natural romantics and spiritual seekers who absorb the unspoken feelings of those around them. However, this extreme permeability can sometimes leave them prone to emotional discontent.

leo_1.title: Leo Decan 1
leo_1.summary: Ruled by the Sun, this decan embodies pure Leo energy, radiating confident leadership and dramatic self-expression.
leo_1.fullText: Covering the first 10 degrees of Leo, this decan is ruled entirely by the Sun. It represents the purest expression of the sign, granting the native immense vitality, noble pride, and a joyous, generous heart. These natural leaders thrive in the spotlight and possess a highly colorful, artistic flair.

leo_2.title: Leo Decan 2
leo_2.summary: Sub-ruled by Jupiter, this decan blends Leo warmth with Sagittarius's adventurous, philosophical, and optimistic expansion.
leo_2.fullText: This decan carries a secondary Sagittarius influence, governed by Jupiter. It expands the Leo ego into broader ideological territories, making these natives incredibly daring, fun-loving, and fiercely independent. They possess a boundless enthusiasm and a conservative yet ambitious drive to conquer new horizons.

leo_3.title: Leo Decan 3
leo_3.summary: Sub-ruled by Mars, this decan infuses Leo pride with Aries's raw courage, passionate drive, and impulsive action.
leo_3.fullText: Influenced by Aries and sub-ruled by Mars, this decan is highly active, passionate, and headstrong. These natives are driven by an aggressive, courageous willpower and a profound need for creative self-assertion. They are impulsive romantics and fearless trailblazers who constantly initiate new projects.

virgo_1.title: Virgo Decan 1
virgo_1.summary: Ruled by Mercury, this decan represents pure Virgo energy, focusing intensely on logical analysis, industry, and practical service.
virgo_1.fullText: Covering the first 10 degrees of Virgo, this decan is ruled purely by Mercury. It highlights the most essential traits of the sign: a highly observant, discriminating mind and a relentless work ethic. Natives are meticulous craftsmen who process reality through logic, order, and dedicated, practical problem-solving.

virgo_2.title: Virgo Decan 2
virgo_2.summary: Sub-ruled by Saturn, this decan blends Virgo detail with Capricorn's enduring discipline and ambitious structural authority.
virgo_2.fullText: This decan carries a secondary Capricorn influence, governed by Saturn. It adds profound endurance, caution, and immense executive ambition to the native's analytical mind. These individuals are exceptionally reliable, disciplined, and capable of shouldering heavy responsibilities to achieve long-term material success.

virgo_3.title: Virgo Decan 3
virgo_3.summary: Sub-ruled by Venus, this decan infuses Virgo precision with Taurus's refined aesthetic taste and sensual discrimination.
virgo_3.fullText: Influenced by Taurus and sub-ruled by Venus, this decan softens the analytical nature with a profound appreciation for beauty and harmony. These natives possess excellent artistic taste, charm, and a deeply loyal, affectionate nature, though they remain highly discerning in their partnerships and material pursuits.

libra_1.title: Libra Decan 1
libra_1.summary: Ruled by Venus, this decan embodies pure Libra energy, characterized by an absolute desire for aesthetic beauty and diplomatic harmony.
libra_1.fullText: Covering the first 10 degrees of Libra, this decan is ruled entirely by Venus. It represents the purest expression of the sign, granting the native immense charm, romantic idealism, and a natural talent for mediation. These individuals process the world through relationships and a deep-seated need for social equilibrium.

libra_2.title: Libra Decan 2
libra_2.summary: Sub-ruled by Uranus, this decan blends Libra diplomacy with Aquarius's progressive, objective, and highly independent intellect.
libra_2.fullText: This decan carries a secondary Aquarius influence, governed by Uranus. It adds a visionary, unconventional edge to the native's social graces. These individuals are brilliant, egalitarian thinkers who easily bridge diverse groups but require significant intellectual freedom and personal space within their partnerships.

libra_3.title: Libra Decan 3
libra_3.summary: Sub-ruled by Mercury, this decan infuses Libra grace with Gemini's articulate communication and sparkling wit.
libra_3.fullText: Influenced by Gemini and sub-ruled by Mercury, this decan operates primarily through active, varied intellectual exchange. These natives are naturally loquacious, persuasive, and highly social, using their brilliant articulation to bring people together and explore diverse, objective viewpoints.

scorpio_1.title: Scorpio Decan 1
scorpio_1.summary: Ruled by Pluto, this decan represents pure Scorpio energy, focusing intensely on profound transformation, loyalty, and psychological depth.
scorpio_1.fullText: Covering the first 10 degrees of Scorpio, this decan is ruled purely by Pluto. It highlights the most essential traits of the sign: incredible magnetism, resilience, and an uncompromising drive for ultimate truth. Natives are fiercely protective, secretive, and experience reality through extreme, soul-deep emotional bonds.

scorpio_2.title: Scorpio Decan 2
scorpio_2.summary: Sub-ruled by Neptune, this decan blends Scorpio intensity with Pisces's mystical, compassionate, and highly intuitive nature.
scorpio_2.fullText: This decan carries a secondary Pisces influence, governed by Neptune. It heightens the native's psychic sensitivity, adding a deeply romantic, spiritual, and artistic dimension to their power. These individuals are profoundly empathetic healers who plunge into life's emotional mysteries with incredible imagination.

scorpio_3.title: Scorpio Decan 3
scorpio_3.summary: Sub-ruled by the Moon, this decan infuses Scorpio willpower with Cancer's profound emotional attachment and maternal protectiveness.
scorpio_3.fullText: Influenced by Cancer and sub-ruled by the Moon, this decan is intensely feeling-oriented and focused on building an impenetrable emotional sanctuary. These natives possess a vivid imagination and an almost psychic empathy, but are highly susceptible to brooding moods and fiercely protecting those they love.

sagittarius_1.title: Sagittarius Decan 1
sagittarius_1.summary: Ruled by Jupiter, this decan embodies pure Sagittarius energy, characterized by a boundless, honest quest for philosophical truth.
sagittarius_1.fullText: Covering the first 10 degrees of Sagittarius, this decan is ruled entirely by Jupiter. It represents the purest expression of the sign, granting the native an inherently optimistic, adventurous, and brutally honest nature. These individuals are visionary explorers who constantly seek higher meaning and freedom.

sagittarius_2.title: Sagittarius Decan 2
sagittarius_2.summary: Sub-ruled by Mars, this decan blends Sagittarius expansion with Aries's courageous, pioneering, and aggressive drive.
sagittarius_2.fullText: This decan carries a secondary Aries influence, governed by Mars. It adds immense courage, initiative, and a passionate temper to the native's philosophical ideals. These individuals are enthusiastic, inspirational leaders who possess the dynamic physical energy required to conquer massive, worldly goals.

sagittarius_3.title: Sagittarius Decan 3
sagittarius_3.summary: Sub-ruled by the Sun, this decan infuses Sagittarius vision with Leo's noble pride, intuitive warmth, and desire for recognition.
sagittarius_3.fullText: Influenced by Leo and sub-ruled by the Sun, this decan operates with magnificent, theatrical flair and brilliant intuition. These natives possess a deeply joyous heart, fine aesthetic taste, and an innate ability to inspire large groups through their sweeping, confident, and highly creative global perspectives.

capricorn_1.title: Capricorn Decan 1
capricorn_1.summary: Ruled by Saturn, this decan represents pure Capricorn energy, focusing intensely on worldly authority, caution, and rigorous discipline.
capricorn_1.fullText: Covering the first 10 degrees of Capricorn, this decan is ruled purely by Saturn. It highlights the most essential traits of the sign: cautious realism, profound ambition, and an unparalleled capacity for hard work. Natives are natural executives who demand tangible achievements and enduring structural security.

capricorn_2.title: Capricorn Decan 2
capricorn_2.summary: Sub-ruled by Venus, this decan blends Capricorn ambition with Taurus's serene fairness, loyalty, and deep love for material beauty.
capricorn_2.fullText: This decan carries a secondary Taurus influence, governed by Venus. It softens the stern nature of Saturn, granting the native an affectionate, charming, and highly dependable personality. These individuals build their security through practical devotion, possessing a structured but deeply sensual aesthetic sense.

capricorn_3.title: Capricorn Decan 3
capricorn_3.summary: Sub-ruled by Mercury, this decan infuses Capricorn structure with Virgo's quick intellect, adaptability, and honorable service.
capricorn_3.fullText: Influenced by Virgo and sub-ruled by Mercury, this decan operates with an organized, profound, and highly flexible mind. These natives possess a sharp intellect, excellent concentration, and treat others with respectful fairness. They engineer abstract ideas into reality through tireless, methodical effort.

aquarius_1.title: Aquarius Decan 1
aquarius_1.summary: Ruled by Uranus, this decan embodies pure Aquarius energy, characterized by brilliant originality and radical independence.
aquarius_1.fullText: Covering the first 10 degrees of Aquarius, this decan is ruled entirely by Uranus. It represents the purest expression of the sign, granting the native a visionary, humanitarian, and highly eccentric spirit. These forward-thinking individuals process the world through objective logic and a rebellious urge for freedom.

aquarius_2.title: Aquarius Decan 2
aquarius_2.summary: Sub-ruled by Mercury, this decan blends Aquarius innovation with Gemini's quick-witted, frank, and highly analytical communication.
aquarius_2.fullText: This decan carries a secondary Gemini influence, governed by Mercury. It sharpens the native's erratic genius into brilliant, fast-paced articulation. These individuals possess a highly original, logical mind and are entirely unafraid to speak their truth, though their intense rationality can sometimes make them appear aloof.

aquarius_3.title: Aquarius Decan 3
aquarius_3.summary: Sub-ruled by Venus, this decan infuses Aquarius logic with Libra's harmonious, progressive romance and strong social associations.
aquarius_3.fullText: Influenced by Libra and sub-ruled by Venus, this decan operates with a unique, egalitarian approach to relationships. These natives are highly people-oriented, possessing an innate visionary charm that naturally attracts diverse, liberating alliances. They seamlessly blend their progressive ideals with diplomatic grace.

pisces_1.title: Pisces Decan 1
pisces_1.summary: Ruled by Neptune, this decan represents pure Pisces energy, focusing intensely on boundless imagination, spirituality, and mystical empathy.
pisces_1.fullText: Covering the first 10 degrees of Pisces, this decan is ruled purely by Neptune. It highlights the most essential traits of the sign: profound psychic sensitivity, artistic genius, and a deeply compassionate soul. Natives process reality entirely through dreams, intuition, and an exquisite yearning for universal redemption.

pisces_2.title: Pisces Decan 2
pisces_2.summary: Sub-ruled by the Moon, this decan blends Piscean mysticism with Cancer's deep emotional attachment and profound maternal comfort.
pisces_2.fullText: This decan carries a secondary Cancer influence, governed by the Moon. It heightens the native's emotional permeability, making them incredibly sensitive, nurturing, and romantically devoted. These individuals are natural healers who absorb the unspoken pain of their environment with profound, maternal grace.

pisces_3.title: Pisces Decan 3
pisces_3.summary: Sub-ruled by Pluto, this decan infuses Piscean empathy with Scorpio's intense, secretive power and absolute psychological transformation.
pisces_3.fullText: Influenced by Scorpio and sub-ruled by Pluto, this decan operates with a piercing, emotionally resilient, and highly active intuition. These natives possess a magnetic, brooding depth and an uncanny ability to navigate complex psychological mysteries. Their profound bonding capacities make them powerful instruments for rebirth.
